title: Constant current source value
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be I = 80 A.

title: Coil resistance value
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be R = 0.5 Ω.

title: Time t3 value
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (3) must be t3 = (√5 + 3)/2 s or its numerical equivalent.

title: Newton's second law for launch
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to the launch phase (0 to t1) to relate the magnetic force to the total mass and acceleration.

title: Magnetic force expression
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the formula for the magnetic force on the coil (F = n B I l) during both the launch and retraction phases.

title: Retraction phase dynamics
description: Important: The solution must set up the equation of motion for the retraction phase (t1 to t3), incorporating the applied force F, the magnetic damping force, and the resulting acceleration.

title: Charge and impulse analysis
description: Important: For finding t3, the solution must link the change in magnetic flux to induced charge and apply the impulse-momentum theorem to the retraction phase after t2.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Deduct points if the student misassigns the direction (sign) of the magnetic force during the retraction phase, treating it as an accelerating instead of a damping force.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award points if the student explicitly shows unit analysis or conversion for key equations, confirming dimensional consistency.

title: Alternative solution path
description: Optional: Award points if the student presents a valid, clearly explained alternative method for any part (e.g., using energy considerations for the launch phase).
